# `get_img_page_thumbnail`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Fetch the thumbnail image for a page of the image list.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit imager build: conditional diagnostics; 32-bit build matches (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | D |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0x1f4480 (64-bit imager build) |

Served by the imager process (4801). Params carry an integer page number. The reply is a thumbnail transfer, or a text error or no-image response. No default or clamp is applied by the handler; page validity is delegated to the page-thumbnail builder. Page numbering and range, and thumbnail assembly and caching, are unresolved.

Side effects: Writes native diagnostic output. Further file, image, database and compression effects are unresolved (tier D).

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"get_img_page_thumbnail"`. [READ] |
| `params` | object\|array | no | - | Page number, as an object or as a positional array [page]. [READ] |

## Example

Request, object-form:

```json
{"id":45,"method":"get_img_page_thumbnail","params":{"page":1}}
```

Request, array-form:

```json
{"id":46,"method":"get_img_page_thumbnail","params":[1]}
```
